Tha Ruairidh a’ dèanamh Linguine Crùbaig fhad ’s a tha Ùisdean cuideachd a’ dèanamh pasta, Ravioli air a lìonadh le feòil crùbaig agus bisque crùbaig. Aig deireadh gnothaich, tha Ruairidh a’ cruthachadh biadh sònraichte, spring rolls crùbaig teth is fuar. The lads love seafood, and the often overlooked and underrated crab features in this episode. To finish, Ruaridh creates a speciality, hot and cold crab spring rolls. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic

A Gaelic learner herself, Joy supports us through pronunciation and vocabulary on topics such as friends, home, work and communication. We meet diligent learners who have embraced speaking Gaelic, from new learners to lapsed native speakers and the on-off learners who have improved their language skills over the decades. And, the intrepid Calum Maclean takes us on adventures to hidden treasures around Scotland. Supporting materials can be found online at www.speakgaelic.scot and in the SpeakGaelic podcasts on BBC Sounds.

San treas sreath de Rathad Ramsay bidh Ramsay MacMahon a’ coinneachadh ri sàr Ghàidheil bho air feadh Alba ‘s iad a’ co-roinn sgeulachdan, cuir luach air nàdar agus a’ cnuasachadh ma beatha. Tha Ramsay a’ coinneachadh ri Coinneach MacFhraing ann an Loch Aillse, an t-àite far an do thogar e agus ris an abair e fhathast a dhachaigh. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Am Balla (The Wall)
programme.desc: Tha Ramsay MacMahon ag ionnsachadh mu bheatha air a’ chrìoch eadar an Fhionnlainn agus an Ruis. Bho thug an Ruis ionnsaigh air an Ucràin ann an 2022 tha a’ chrìoch air dùnadh gu tur, ag atharrachadh beatha dhaoine air gach taobh. Anns an Fhionnlainn, cluinnidh Ramsay sgeulachdan bho theaghlaichean a chaidh a’ sgaradh bho an luchd-gràdh air taobh eile na crìche. Coinnichidh e riuthsan air a bheil an dleastanas ‘son tèarainteachd aig a’ chrìoch agus cluinnidh e bho dhaoine a chaill am beòshlaint’ gu h-obann air sgàth an dùnaidh. Ramsay MacMahon learns about life along the border between Finland and Russia. Since Russia’s attack on Ukraine in 2022 the border has closed completely, transforming the lives of people on both sides. In Finland, Ramsay hears the stories of families who have been separated from their loved ones on the other side, meets those responsible for securing the border and hears from people who have lost their livelihood overnight because of its closure. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Faodail
programme.desc: Tha Tasglann Fhilm Faodail a’ tarraing aire gu filmichean dhùthchasach Innse Gall bho na 1930an gu na 80an, a bha caillte ach a-nis glèidhte don ghinealach ri teachd. Tha bhana Cinema Sgìre Leantainneach a’ siubhal nan eilean, a’ taisbeanadh fhilmichean sna sgìrean ionadail, le cothrom am faicinn air-loidhne air feadh an t-saoghail. Cuirear aithris bheairteach ùr riutha, a’ buntainn ris a’ Ghàidhealtachd, airson luchd-amhairc an là an-diugh. The Faodail Film Archive celebrates lost indigenous film collections from the 1930s-1980s in the Outer Hebrides, preserving the archive for future generations. The Cinema Sgìre Continuing mobile cinema van travels the islands, showcasing footage to local communities, making them accessible globally online and adding rich new narratives relevant to the Gàidhealtachd for contemporary audiences. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

Còmhla ri a chompanach sreap, Calum Gibb, bidh Coinneach a’ dìreadh ‘Stetind’, stùc le eachdraidh bheairteach a tha air mac-meanmna luchd-sreap a ghlacadh airson còrr is ceud bliadhna. Seeking adventure on a grand scale in Europe, Coinneach Rankin travels to the mountain paradise of Norway. Along with his climbing partner, Calum Gibb, Coinneach makes an ascent of Stetind, a peak with a storied past that has captured the imagination of mountaineers for well over a century. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

He's delighted when he discovers the flock's barn needs a good tidy-up, until he comes across a wonky picture that just won't hang straight.

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc: Tha Hilda, Flòraidh is Daibhidh a’ feuchainn ri bràistean Sgùdan Sporais às ùr a chosnadh. Air sgàth sin, tha 'ad dol a’ shireadh planntraisean annasach ionadail – agus abair g’ eil sin na chuairt-dànachd glè inntinneach. Hilda, Flòraidh and Daibhidh are trying to earn new Sgùdan Sporrais badges. They go in search of rare, local plants, and this turns into a very interesting adventure.

programme.title: Seòid a' Chidsin - The Kitchen Coves
programme.desc: Abair gu bheil maorach a’ còrdadh ri na seòid agus anns a’ phrògram-sa, tha iad a’ còcaireachd le crùbag, rud air a bheilear tric a’ dèanamh dearmaid. Tha Ùisdean ag ullachadh ciad cùrsa dathte a’ cleachdadh feòil chrùbaig dhonn agus deiseag. Tha Ruairidh a’ dèanamh Linguine Crùbaig fhad ’s a tha Ùisdean cuideachd a’ dèanamh pasta, Ravioli air a lìonadh le feòil crùbaig agus bisque crùbaig. Aig deireadh gnothaich, tha Ruairidh a’ cruthachadh biadh sònraichte, spring rolls crùbaig teth is fuar. The lads love seafood, and the often overlooked and underrated crab features in this episode. Uisdean prepares a colourful crab starter using brown and velvet crab meat. Ruaridh makes an interesting crab linguini while Uisdean continues the pasta thread by making ravioli filled with crab meat and a crab bisque. To finish, Ruaridh creates a speciality, hot and cold crab spring rolls. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Singer and Gaelic teacher Margaret Macleod Nicholson is Joy’s studio guest, and Calum Maclean visits Scotland’s newest city and once ancient capital, Dunfermline.

programme.title: Port An Obain
programme.desc: We meet Oban resident Duncan MacNeil, who works as a Gaelic officer, and also Sileas Sinclair, who keeps alive the family passion for traditional music.

programme.title: Ro Thrath don t-Saoghal/Born too Soon
programme.desc: Mu dheireadh thall, tha a triùir leanabain aig Kinga na gàirdeanan, fhad ’s a tha Emily a’ dol tro dheuchainnean a bharrachd. Tha fradharc Diane ann an cunnart, gheibh Treasa agus Ian naidheachd a dh’fhàgas an cridheachan briste, agus tha Tom Òg a’ ruighinn clach-mhìle chudromach. Kinga finally holds her triplets together, while Emily undergoes further tests. Diane faces a risk to her sight, Treasa and Ian receive devastating news, and Tom Óg reaches a key milestone. Dubbed in Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Fraochy Bay
programme.desc: Tha am bard fhathast a' feitheamh cobhair ach chaneil sgeul air a bhata-teasairginn ach tha a sgioba sin air an cul a chuir ri treanadh agus fior suidheachadh eiginneach rompa. Tha croitear agus a chuid chaorach air a dhol a-mach air a cheile. Torquil Farquhar has just been left stranded on a dummy iceberg in Fraochy Bay as the lifeboat abandons its training session and heads off to a real life emergency. A local crofter is being held hostage by his mutinous sheep.

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: An greimean lòin as fheàrr le Abigail, 's e Buntàta Cruasbach Sàiste. 'Ad cho blast' 's a tha 'ad rin ithe. Tha 'n seòrs' aice-se soirbh a dhèanamh; feumaidh tu fheuchainn. Abigail’s favourite snack lunch is crispy sage potatoes. It's as nice to look at as to eat and her version is easy to make - you must try it! In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Glan Fhèin
programme.desc: Angela and Katie compete against Shonnie and Calum from rival company Sgiobalta. It’s an upstairs-downstairs, girls v boys clean-off where the winner gets the contract. Things get messy, featuring stains, smudges and romantic complications. The timing isn’t perfect, as it clashes with the anniversary of Katie’s infamous disastrous reality TV appearance. Meanwhile, Betty and Dido are on a publicity push where they ditch leaflets and embrace dancing on social media. And Daniel makes a new furry friend as he gets busy with his air freshener.

programme.title: An t-Uisge/Rain Stories
programme.desc: Anne Lundon hears about acid rain, first identified after the Industrial Revolution.

programme.title: Dàna | Scotland's Wild Side
programme.desc: A’ sireadh Dànachd anns an Roinn Eòrpa, tha Coinneach MacFhraing a’ siubhal gu dùthaich nam beann iongantach – Nirribhidh. Còmhla ri a chompanach sreap, Calum Gibb, bidh Coinneach a’ dìreadh ‘Stetind’, stùc le eachdraidh bheairteach a tha air mac-meanmna luchd-sreap a ghlacadh airson còrr is ceud bliadhna. Seeking adventure on a grand scale in Europe, Coinneach Rankin travels to the mountain paradise of Norway. Along with his climbing partner, Calum Gibb, Coinneach makes an ascent of Stetind, a peak with a storied past that has captured the imagination of mountaineers for well over a century. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: Thig air turas eile sgoinneil le na h-Abadas. 'S e 'put' am facal ùr a tha aca. Cò a thèid air a thòrr an-diugh: Hari, Ela, neo Seren? Join the Abadas for another 'abadobedee' adventure. This episode's word is 'buoy'. Who will be chosen to find today's exciting new word; Hari, Ela or Seren?

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Tha Sif, Pipp agus Bran a’ gabhail pàirt ann an latha chleasan nan Losgann. Ziff, Pipp and Button compete in their own Froggie sports day.

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha seillean glacte ann an uamhag Bhernie agus, gun e air biadh fhaighinn, tha e cho fann ‘s nach dèan e a shlighe dhachaigh! Ge-tà, tha Oona ‘s Baba deònach a dhol a-lorg biadh dha gus am fàs e làidir a-rithist! There’s a bee trapped in Bernie’s grotto but without anything to eat, he has become too weak to escape and make his way back to the hive. However, Oona and Baba are on hand to find and bring him the food he needs to build his strength back up!

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha Mossy airson a dhol air turas-ionmhais bidhe ach ‘s ann a dh’ fheumas an sgioba dhol air misean-seilg' eadar-dhealaichte 's Pip ‘s Pop air a dhol am falach air Otto bochd! Mossy wants the gang to join him on a food hunt, but they are all called on a different sort of search when Pip and Pop decide to hide on poor Otto!

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha am Màidsear air fear de na h-innleachdan feumail aige a chruthachadh, ach chan eil còir aig duine beantainn ris fhad 's a tha e air falbh. Bu mhòr am beud nach do dh'èist Beag ris. Major has come up with one of his useful inventions, but no-one is allowed to touch it while he is away. It’s a shame that Beag didn’t listen to him.

programme.title: Orain CBeebies
programme.desc: Taghadh farsaing de dh’òrain bho Carrie, Linda, Ruairidh agus sgioba CBeebies ALBA. A selection of songs from Carrie, Linda, Ruairidh and the CBeebies ALBA presenters.

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Iain MacAonghais a’ leughadh Measgaichte. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh agus a dhealbhachadh le Arree Chung agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Mòrag Stiùbhart. A bedtime story for young children. Iain MacInnes reads Measgaichte, written and illustrated by Arree Chung and translated into Gaelic by Morag Stewart.

programme.title: SpongeBob
programme.desc: Man Ray rents Squidward's house. Tha An Sòrnan a’ gabhail taigh Ghiobaird air mhàl.

programme.title: An Sgoil
programme.desc: Leis mar a chaidh sgrùdadh na sgoile an-uiridh, tha bòrd na sgoile air Leas-Cheannard ùr, Ms Dallas, a thoirt a-steach gus sùil ghèir a chumail air Mgr Mackle. Bidh sinn a' coinneachadh ri tidsearean ùra agus ri feadhainn air a bheil sinn air eòlas a chuir roimhe. After last year’s school inspection, the school board has appointed a new deputy head, Ms Dallas, to keep an eye on Mr Mackle. We meet new teachers alongside some recognisable personalities.

programme.title: Alba Eagalach
programme.desc: Tha sgioba CBBC ALBA a’ toirt thugainn cuid de na sgeulachdan agus na tachartasan as eagalaiche ann an eachdraidh na h-Alba. Anns a’ phrògram seo, coinnichidh sinn ri Uilleam Uallas agus cluinnidh sinn mun bheatha eagalach a bh’ aige ach chan eil e fhèin ro dheònach bruidhinn mu dheidhinn! CBBC ALBA brings us some of the scariest stories from Scottish history. In this episode, we meet William Wallace and uncover the grisly details of his life. Surprisingly, he doesn't seem too keen to talk about these!

programme.title: Geamaichean Gorach
programme.desc: Mar ‘s àbhaist, tha Coinneach Clogaid a’ feuchainn ri casg a chur air a h-uile Farpaiseach eile. Na can rium gu bheil e dol a bhuannachadh an trup-sa, ge-tà? ‘S cinnteach nach eil? As ever, Coinneach Clogaid is trying to stop all the other competitors. Don’t tell me he’s going to win this time though. Surely not?

programme.title: Belle and Sebastian
programme.desc: Tha mòran ri innse an-diugh – mar a theich Sebastian ri Linn burraidheachd Chamshron, is tha sinn cuideachd ’g ionnsachadh mun chiad choinneachadh le Belle. There’s much to tell today - how Sebastian decided to run away as a result of Cameron’s bullying, and we learn about his first meeting with Belle.

programme.title: Seonaidh | Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Tha an tuathanach a' co-dhùnadh raon goilf a thogail air an tuathanas gus aire an sguibhir ionadail a ghlacadh. Nuair a mhothachas an treud gun caill iad an dump aca air a bheil iad cho dèidheil, feumaidh iad a thighinn an àrda le plana innleachdail gus a shàbhaladh. The farmer decides to build a golf course on the farm to impress the local squire. When the flock discover they'll lose their beloved dump, they must come up with an imaginative solution to try and save it.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: Tha Bagelean Abigail fìor bhlast' agus sònraicht' 'son bruinse no lòn, no fiù 's aig àm sam bith, 's 'ad gad shàsachadh ann an dòigh nach gabh inns' 's iad fèìr taght' 'son an roinn leis an teaghlach no le caraidean. Abigail’s bagels are a very special and tasty brunch or lunch, or anytime experience, satisfying to the extreme and just the thing to share with family and friends. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Fonn mo Bheatha
programme.desc: Ceòl agus còmhradh le Cathy Ann Nic a Phi còmhla ri Iseabail NicAsgailll. Music and chat programme presented by Cathy Ann MacPhee with guest Ishbel MacAskill. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Bus Ghlaschu/Glasgow Bus
programme.desc: Bus Ghlaschu - sreath à Èirinn a’ toirt sùil air na caractaran air a’ bhus eadar Glaschu is Dùn nan Gall is na sgeulachdan timcheall air na tursan aca. A look at the characters and stories around the bus that runs between Donegal and Glasgow.

programme.title: Mas Fhior
programme.desc: Seo an fharpais-cheist far a bheil barrachd air eòlas coitcheann a dhìth gus buannachadh. Le Niall Iain Dòmnhallach aig an stiùir cluichidh na sgiobaidhean anns an stiùideo an aghaidh an ochdnar Mas Fhìoraich a tha a’ cluich bhon dachaighean fhèin agus a tha a’ cur nan ceistean. A’ strì an aghaidh na Mas Fhìoraich airson feuchainn air an duais mhòr, tha DK is Kenna agus Kirsty is Seònaid. Presented by Niall Iain MacDonald, this is the quiz show where more than general knowledge is required to win. Playing from the comfort of their own homes are the Pretenders, and they are the ones posing the questions. Battling the Pretenders to win the big prize are DK and Kenna, and Kirsty and Janet. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Third Lanark
programme.desc: Ann an 1967, agus e faisg air ceud bliadhna a dh'aois, chaidh cluba ball-coise le eachdraidh shòisealta is chultarail sònraichte à bith. As dèidh 95 bliadhna de dh'eachdraidh phròiseil chaidh innse gun robh Cluba Lùth-chleasachd Third Lanark banc-briste, agus chaidh na geataichean gu Pàirce Chathkin an dùnadh airson an turas mu dheireadh. Tha Third Lanark ag innse an sgeulachd mu dheidhinn cluba coimhearsnachd sònraichte, a' coimhead ri mar a chaidh a stèidheachadh, na làithean buidhe a thuilleadh air na làithean a bu dhuirche an uair a chaidh an cluba à bith. In 1967, as it edged towards its centenary, a much-loved social and cultural institution was consigned to history. Following 95 years of emotional highs and lows, Glasgow's Third Lanark Athletic Club was bankrupt, and the gates to Cathkin Park were closed. Third Lanark is the fascinating story of this iconic community club, exploring its formation and existence, as well as its catastrophic collapse.

programme.title: Ciad-fàthan nan Creutairean/Wild Senses
programme.desc: Tha Còmhraidhean Ceimigeach a’ toirt sùil air mar a tha beathaichean a’ dèananmh feum de bhlas agus fàileadh airson conaltradh agus maireachdainn beò ann an dòighean do-chreidsinneach. This episode tunes into how animals use taste and smell to survive and communicate in ways that defy belief. Dubbed in Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Skipinnish Aig A' Chaisteal
programme.desc: Skipinnish le Last of the Hunters ann an cuideachd na mìltean de luchd-leantainn aig cuirm-chiùil a’ comharrachadh 25 bliadhna de Skipinnish, bho Chaisteal Dhùn Èideann. Skipinnish perform Last of the Hunters in front of thousands of fans at a concert celebrating 25 years of the band, from Edinburgh Castle.

programme.title: Seirm
programme.desc: Prògram de cheòl traidiseanta agus freumhach air a lìbhrigeadh le Màiri Anna NicUalraig. A’ taisbeanaidh chlàraidhean is chòmhraidhean a chaidh a dhèanamh aig àm Celtic Connections 2024, chìte cuid den luchd-ciùil a b’ fheàrr a bha aig an fhèis, leithid Talisk, Julie Fowlis/Éamon Doorley/Zoë Conway/John Mc Intyre, Glen Hansard & Breanndán Ó Beaglaoich, Buffalo Nichols agus Pine Tree Flyers. Traditional and roots music show presented by Mary Ann Kennedy. Filmed during Celtic Connections 2024, Seirm showcases bespoke recordings and conversations with some of the best artists appearing at the festival. This episode features performances from Talisk; Julie Fowlis, Éamon Doorley, Zoë Conway, John McIntyre; Glen Hansard & Breanndán Ó Beaglaoich, Buffalo Nichols and Pine Tree Flyers. In Gaelic with English subtitles.
